title: Heat kernel estimates on book-like graphs
summary: In this paper, we prove two-sided heat kernel estimates on what we call "book-like" graphs. These are graphs consisting of pieces that satisfy the parabolic Harnack inequality that are glued together in a sufficiently nice way over a possibly infinite set of vertices. The prototypical example is gluing a copy of the square four-dimensional lattice $\mathbb{Z}^4,$ a copy of $\mathbb{Z}^5$, and a copy of $\mathbb{Z}^6$ by identifying their $x_1$-axes and taking the lazy simple random walk on this glued graph.
